flat-color.name: Flat Color
flat-color.description: Flat design with solid vibrant colors, no gradients or shadows. Clean shapes, modern and friendly. Like Material Design or Fluent icons.
flat-color.prompt_suffix: flat design, solid vibrant colors, no gradients, no shadows, clean geometric shapes, modern material style, centered composition, simple and minimal, icon for presentation

line-monochrome.name: Line Monochrome
line-monochrome.description: Single-color line icon with uniform stroke width. Minimalist and elegant. Easy to recolor to match any theme. Like Feather or Heroicons style.
line-monochrome.prompt_suffix: line icon, single color, uniform stroke width, minimalist, elegant, thin lines, outline style, feather icon style, centered, clean, simple, no fill, vector-like

line-color.name: Line Color
line-color.description: Line icon with accent colors. Outlined shapes with selective color fills. Modern and professional, like Tabler or Phosphor icons.
line-color.prompt_suffix: outlined line icon with accent colors, selective color fills, modern professional style, uniform stroke, tabler icon style, centered, clean design, vector-like

3d-render.name: 3D Render
3d-render.description: 3D rendered icon with soft shadows, depth, and subtle gradients. Glossy and modern, like macOS Big Sur or iOS app icons.
3d-render.prompt_suffix: 3D rendered icon, soft shadows, depth, subtle gradients, glossy modern style, rounded shapes, macOS Big Sur style, centered, high quality render, clay-like material

duotone.name: Duotone
duotone.description: Two-tone icon using a primary and secondary color. Stylish and contemporary, like Font Awesome duotone or Phosphor duotone.
duotone.prompt_suffix: duotone icon, two-tone color scheme, primary and secondary color, stylish contemporary, font awesome duotone style, layered opacity, centered, modern design

filled-color.name: Filled Color
filled-color.description: Solid filled icon with bold colors. Strong visual presence, like Material filled or Ionicons style.
filled-color.prompt_suffix: filled solid icon, bold vibrant colors, strong visual presence, material filled style, ionicons style, centered, rounded corners, clean and bold

isometric.name: Isometric
isometric.description: Isometric 3D icon with consistent 30-degree angle projection. Technical yet approachable, like unDraw 3D or 3D icon kits.
isometric.prompt_suffix: isometric 3D icon, 30-degree angle projection, consistent perspective, soft lighting, pastel colors, technical yet approachable, undraw 3D style, centered, clean background

hand-drawn.name: Hand Drawn
hand-drawn.description: Hand-drawn icon with organic lines and sketch-like quality. Warm and approachable, like Streamline Hand-drawn or Notion style.
hand-drawn.prompt_suffix: hand-drawn icon, organic lines, sketch-like quality, warm and approachable, rough strokes, streamline hand-drawn style, notion style, centered, charming imperfection

gradient.name: Gradient
gradient.description: Icon with smooth color gradients. Vibrant and eye-catching, like modern SaaS landing page icons.
gradient.prompt_suffix: icon with smooth color gradients, vibrant and eye-catching, modern SaaS style, glassmorphism accent, soft glow, centered, premium feel, high quality

minimal-solid.name: Minimal Solid
minimal-solid.description: Minimalist solid silhouette icon. High contrast, bold and simple shapes. Like SF Symbols or simple geometric icons.
minimal-solid.prompt_suffix: minimalist solid silhouette icon, high contrast, bold simple shapes, SF Symbols style, single color fill, no details, centered, maximum clarity, vector-like

backgrounds.transparent-friendly: plain solid pure white background, evenly lit, no texture, for easy background removal
